opennyai_summary.decision:
This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is directed against the judgment and award dated 28.05.2024, passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Sonitpur at Tezpur, in MAC Case No.67/2018.
It is to be noted here that vide impugned judgment and award dated 28.05.2024, the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Sonitpur at Tezpur, has directed the appellant to pay a sum of Rs.9,53,000/- being the compensation with 7.5% interest per annum from the date of filing the claim petition till payment.
This appeal is admitted for hearing, subject to depositing 50% of the awarded amount before the Registry of this Court within a period of 2(two) weeks from today.
